about: integration review fixtures for scripts/context_rule_adapter.py against the staged data/cultural_context tables. Real registry rows unless marked synthetic. No fixture evaluates a recipe: item_evidence is a hypothetical tag assessment, never derived from corpus labels.

cases.id: NA-01 no occasion declared: source S1 family does not apply, even if a recipe carries a corpus Occasion tag
PROHIB-01 admits_no_food: FAIL for every item plus explicit abstention
PROHIB-02 admits_no_food with a standing-rule tradition: standing law never relaxes a total fast
UNK-01 narrowing rule not evaluable (sequential_abstinence): UNKNOWN, never PASS
UNK-03 no rule recorded and dietary_status not_reviewed: UNKNOWN (absence is not permission)
UNK-04 occasion not in registry: UNKNOWN
FB-01 fast-breaking context, tradition with a sourced standing rule (islam/halal): standing rule narrows, UNKNOWN at 0.11.0
FB-02 fast_breaking rule, Bahai tradition: standing bahai_alcohol_prohibition narrows
FB-03 fast_breaking rule, Jain tradition (standing rule unsourced, empty upstream): NO_CONSTRAINT, not PASS
NC-01 confirmed_no_constraint without a standing rule: NO_CONSTRAINT
NC-02 confirmed_no_constraint in a tradition with a standing rule: standing rule still applies
CONF-01 conflict: institutional langar rule + standing khalsa_rehat compose (union of exclusions), descriptive tier is not hard-constraint eligible
CONF-02 unsourced narrowing rule (mourning_restriction): evaluable in source S1, reported in its own tier, not hard-constraint eligible
SECT-01 sect-specific occasion with a rule requires the user's sect as declared evidence
SYN-01 synthetic (destination_executable forced true in memory): excluded tag evidenced -> FAIL
SYN-02 synthetic: every relevant tag assessed absent -> PASS
SYN-03 synthetic: a relevant tag not assessed -> UNKNOWN, never PASS
